title: Codex Learning Path
summary: Learn Codex through controlled repository work, explicit project guidance, and verifiable engineering loops.

first-controlled-task.title: Complete a controlled first task
first-controlled-task.objective: Learn how context and prompting shape a small, observable Codex task.
first-controlled-task.risk: Begin in a practice repository and avoid credentials, publishing, deployments, and remote writes.

project-instructions.title: Establish project instructions
project-instructions.objective: Make stable repository constraints discoverable through the correct AGENTS.md hierarchy.
project-instructions.risk: Keep instructions scoped, testable, and free of secrets or transient task details.

approvals-and-sandbox.title: Understand approvals and sandboxing
approvals-and-sandbox.objective: Recognize when Codex can proceed and when it must request permission for a higher-risk action.
approvals-and-sandbox.risk: External writes, credentials, destructive commands, and sandbox escapes always need deliberate review.

implementation-loop.title: Close the implementation loop
implementation-loop.objective: Move from repository inspection through a focused edit, tests, diff review, and code review.
implementation-loop.risk: Do not accept a completion claim without checking the changed behavior and actual evidence.

mcp.title: Connect a read-only MCP server
mcp.objective: Use an MCP integration while keeping tools, data, and authentication within a known boundary.
mcp.risk: Treat tool output as untrusted input and review every capability before enabling writes.

skills-and-plugins.title: Package reusable capabilities
skills-and-plugins.objective: Turn one repeated workflow into a small, documented skill or plugin with a clear trigger.
skills-and-plugins.risk: Keep permissions narrow and avoid hiding remote changes or credentials inside automation.

cloud-and-ci.title: Understand cloud tasks and CI
cloud-and-ci.objective: Trace how local intent becomes a cloud task or CI job without executing an unauthorized write.
cloud-and-ci.risk: Repository tokens, comments, commits, pull requests, releases, and deployments require explicit authorization.

codex-explore-read-only.title: Explore a repository without writing
codex-explore-read-only.instruction: Ask Codex to identify the repository structure, active guidance, and narrowest useful test command.
codex-explore-read-only.done_when: The response cites concrete files and leaves the workspace unchanged.

codex-improve-first-prompt.title: Improve the first prompt
codex-improve-first-prompt.instruction: Rewrite a vague request with a concrete goal, scope, constraints, and verification target.
codex-improve-first-prompt.done_when: Codex can restate the task and complete one small, verified change without scope drift.

codex-create-project-guidance.title: Create project guidance
codex-create-project-guidance.instruction: Add one stable, testable repository rule to the appropriate AGENTS.md file.
codex-create-project-guidance.done_when: The rule is concise and its directory scope is unambiguous.

codex-verify-guidance-discovery.title: Verify guidance discovery
codex-verify-guidance-discovery.instruction: Start a fresh task and ask Codex to list the effective project instructions and their sources.
codex-verify-guidance-discovery.done_when: The output matches the repository instruction hierarchy.

codex-classify-operation-boundaries.title: Classify operation boundaries
codex-classify-operation-boundaries.instruction: Sort example actions into read, local write, command execution, external write, and destructive operation.
codex-classify-operation-boundaries.done_when: Each action has a justified sandbox and approval expectation.

codex-verify-approval-path.title: Verify an approval path
codex-verify-approval-path.instruction: Use a harmless practice case to observe when Codex proceeds, asks, or refuses.
codex-verify-approval-path.done_when: The expected boundary is visible and no unauthorized side effect occurs.

codex-complete-implementation-loop.title: Complete a focused implementation
codex-complete-implementation-loop.instruction: Have Codex inspect, edit, and test one narrowly scoped behavior.
codex-complete-implementation-loop.done_when: The intended behavior works and the relevant check passes.

codex-review-diff-and-tests.title: Review the diff and tests
codex-review-diff-and-tests.instruction: Inspect the diff and test output, then run a regression-focused code review.
codex-review-diff-and-tests.done_when: Unexpected changes are removed and remaining risk is explicit.

codex-connect-read-only-mcp.title: Connect a read-only MCP
codex-connect-read-only-mcp.instruction: Configure a local or test MCP server that exposes only the read capability needed for the exercise.
codex-connect-read-only-mcp.done_when: Codex lists and invokes only the expected read-only tool.

codex-audit-mcp-scope.title: Audit the MCP boundary
codex-audit-mcp-scope.instruction: Review tool schemas, credentials, returned data, and handling of untrusted output.
codex-audit-mcp-scope.done_when: The integration exposes no capability or data beyond the stated scope.

codex-package-repeatable-workflow.title: Package a repeated workflow
codex-package-repeatable-workflow.instruction: Choose a small repeated process and express it as a documented skill or plugin.
codex-package-repeatable-workflow.done_when: The capability has a clear trigger, inputs, outputs, and ownership boundary.

codex-verify-reusable-capability.title: Verify the reusable capability
codex-verify-reusable-capability.instruction: Run the capability on a controlled example and inspect every resulting change.
codex-verify-reusable-capability.done_when: It behaves predictably, preserves unrelated files, and documents required permissions.

codex-inspect-cloud-ci-flow.title: Inspect a cloud and CI flow
codex-inspect-cloud-ci-flow.instruction: Trace task inputs, environment, permissions, checks, and outputs without starting a remote job.
codex-inspect-cloud-ci-flow.done_when: The execution path and all privileged steps are identified.

codex-verify-no-remote-write.title: Confirm the remote-write boundary
codex-verify-no-remote-write.instruction: List every action that could comment, push, open a pull request, release, or deploy.
codex-verify-no-remote-write.done_when: Each remote write has an explicit authorization point and none was executed.
